name: Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht
description: Senator Padmé Amidala piloted an H-type Nubian yacht to alleged negotiations with the InterGalactic Banking Clan in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. The yacht was destroyed when it was intercepted by General Grievous's Malevolence.

data.name: Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht
data.destroyed: 22 BBY, aboard the Malevolence, near the Kaliida Nebula
